question: In India, from June to September which type of weather prevails?
solution:
The correct answer is __**monsoon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The weather that prevails is the rainy season that lasts from June to September.
 
• It is also known as **Southwest Monsoon.**
 
• The Southwest Monsoon is the Indian subcontinent's primary rainy season.
 
• During this time, the country receives nearly 75% of its annual rainfall.
 
• These winds bring rains towards the end of the summer due to high pressure built in the Indian Ocean.
 
• This monsoon strikes Kerala in the month of June and by mid-Oct leaves the country 
 
• Average wind speed 30km/hr
 
• The Southwest Monsoon has two branches
 
• The Arabian Sea branch contributes to 80% of this monsoon and moves northward to Delhi.
 
• The Bay of Bengal branch contributes 20% and moves up to Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Winter Season__: January - February

__
 
• During this season, the northeast trade winds prevail over the country.
 
• They blow from land to sea and hence, for the most part of the country, it is a dry season. 
 
• During the cold season, the days are warm and the night is cold.
 
• During this period the northeast trade wind blows from land to sea.

**Autumn season__ - September end to November**

__
 
• It marks the transition from summer to winter.

**Spring season__ - February to March**

 
• Harvesting festivals like Bihu, Baisakhi, Pongal, etc., are celebrated during this time.
 
• It is the time when flowers bloom and trees begin to grow and reproduce
